state.problem: A fresh Arch install builds koompi-quickshell-git (sdata/dist-arch/koompi-quickshell-git/PKGBUILD) from a pinned quickshell commit. On today's toolchain (gcc 16, Qt 6.11) the old pin and v0.3.1 both fail to moc; J48 reproduced it in a clean container. Every fresh install dies at this step.
state.seat: The founder's machine does not run koompi-quickshell-git. It runs Arch's official package `quickshell 0.3.1-1` from [extra]. Every test in tests/ and every nested run this campaign ran against that 0.3.1.
state.pinned_pkg_does: Builds quickshell from source; pins qt6-base and qt6-declarative to the exact build-time versions because quickshell links Qt's private ABI (pacman then blocks Qt upgrades until a rebuild); also pulls ~15 extra runtime deps the shell needs (qt6-5compat, qt6-multimedia, qt6-positioning, kirigami, kdialog, syntax-highlighting, etc.). No source patches.
state.arch_pkg: [extra] quickshell 0.3.1-1, rebuilt by Arch with each Qt bump, so the private-ABI problem is Arch's to keep in step. Does not pull the koompi extra deps; those would move into a small koompi meta package or install-deps.sh.
state.J48_change: Commit 20e836c9b moves the pin to v0.3.2 (4f508be5), which compiles. Nobody has run the shell on 0.3.2; the seat is 0.3.1, so fresh installs would run a version no test covered.
state.reversibility: All on dev; nothing deployed. A fresh-install path change, not a seat change.

J48_quickshell_source.instructions: Where should a fresh KOOMPI install get Quickshell from?

criteria.arch_quickshell_package: Depend on Arch's [extra] quickshell and keep the extra deps in a koompi meta package. Strongest case: it is exactly what the seat and every test run, Arch keeps it built against current Qt, and no pin or rebuild after Qt bumps is ours to maintain.
criteria.pin_v032: Merge J48's pin move to v0.3.2. Strongest case: keeps the existing packaging and its Qt version lock; v0.3.2 compiles today. Cost: fresh installs run an untested Quickshell, and the next gcc or Qt bump can break the pin again.
criteria.pin_v032_after_test: Merge the v0.3.2 pin only after the full suite runs against a locally built 0.3.2. Strongest case: keeps the packaging and closes the test gap. Cost: an extra build and suite run, and the pin still breaks on future toolchain bumps.
